lesson.title: Procedure 401 – PLAINCLOTHES OPERATIONS
objectives: Apply assignment rules for plainclothes units, including exclusions and supervisor approvals.
Broadcast required advisories when plainclothes and uniformed units respond to serious incidents.
Handle stakeout operation notifications, postings, and approved radio terminology to protect cover.
Apply authorization rules for broadcasting full details during dangerous stakeout situations.
Maintain continuity by informing relief dispatchers and notifying radio supervisors of problems.

questions.stem: Procedure 401: Why should assignment of plainclothes officers be avoided in most cases?

choices.text: To prevent confrontations between uniformed and non-uniformed personnel

questions.solution: To prevent confrontations between uniformed and non-uniformed personnel
questions.hints: Use the plainclothes operations procedure wording.

source.coverage: Response to most assignments will be made by marked units containing uniformed Police Officers. Assignment of Plainclothes Officers should be avoided, in most cases, to prevent confrontations between uniformed and non-uniformed personnel.

questions.stem: Procedure 401: When may plainclothes units be assigned to crimes in progress?

choices.text: When no uniformed units are available (excluding sale of drugs in any building)
Any time a crime is reported
Only when a supervisor is on scene

questions.solution: When no uniformed units are available (excluding sale of drugs in any building)
questions.hints: Use the plainclothes operations procedure wording.

source.coverage: Plainclothes units may be assigned to crimes in progress when no uniformed units are available (excluding a report of sale of drugs in any building).

questions.stem: Procedure 401: What must the dispatcher do when plainclothes and uniformed units are both responding to a serious incident?

choices.text: Broadcast an advisory message and remind plainclothes to display the color of the day

questions.stem: Procedure 401: Who must supervising officers notify prior to starting any plainclothes operation?

source.coverage: Supervising Officers of all Plainclothes Operations must notify Communications Section Platoon Commanders prior to start; all incoming calls regarding Plainclothes Operations forwarded to Platoon Commanders/Assistant Platoon Commanders.

questions.stem: Procedure 401: If an incident occurs at the posted plainclothes-operation location, what should the dispatcher advise?

choices.text: That only undercover units should respond
That a stakeout is happening there
That there may be plainclothes officers in the vicinity/location

questions.solution: That there may be plainclothes officers in the vicinity/location
questions.hints: Use the plainclothes operations procedure wording.

source.coverage: Coordinator gives notice to radio supervisor for posting at terminal; when incident occurs at posted location, advise units there are plainclothes in vicinity (particularly Housing/Transit); avoid saying 'stakeout' over air; use approved terminology.

questions.stem: Procedure 401: When may the dispatcher give full details over the air at a known stakeout location?

source.coverage: If dangerous situation at known stakeout with potential injuries, dispatcher may give full details over air, but only if authorized by Radio Supervisor.
